The key is finding a watch that does both jobs well: accurate golf distances, automatic activity tracking, heart rate, sleep monitoring, and enough battery life to last multiple rounds.

My top choice would be the Garmin vívoactive 5 if you want a balanced everyday smartwatch, or a Garmin Approach S12 if golf matters much more than fitness.
